program.title: Section 232 — timber, lumber, and derivative wood products
program.detail: Proclamation 10976. Softwood timber/lumber 10% additional; upholstered wooden furniture and completed kitchen cabinets/vanities 25% (UK 10%, JP/EU 15%). Autos 232 (Proclamation 10908) wins if both apply.

source: CSMS #66492057 — GUIDANCE: Section 232 Import Duties on Timber, Lumber, and their Derivative Products

buckets.label: Completed kitchen cabinets and vanities and parts

notes: If the good is also subject to Section 232 automobiles / auto parts (Proclamation 10908), wood 232 does not apply.
9903.76.04 is 0% additional for articles on the cabinet HTS list that are not completed kitchen cabinets/vanities or parts — claim flags.s232_wood_not_cabinet.
